scope: Explicit source-global binding preparation; actual native global installation remains a provider operation.

getterRegressionDiscovery.definition: Two newly added regression controls against the initial local bootstrap, before the snapshot fix. The subsequent test edit only added an explicit variable type and a type-only import.

after.snapshotCorrection: Read top-level capability references, origin/cloner, and both origin scalars once before validation and registration. Construct Navigator and error policy first, then register Performance and URLPattern using stable snapshots. Keep the original capability object only for idempotent identity.

runtimeClockRequirement: The provider clock is relative to the selected environment origin; this bootstrap requires monotonic origin offset zero. Epoch correlation and native coarsening are provider guarantees. General createPerformance offset support is unchanged.
testProviders: Deterministic error/Promise driver, Node structuredClone as test injection, and explicit unsupported URL component primitives. These do not implement the actual native installation.
nativeIntegration: not verified: actual globals, canonical field access, callback context/cleanup, Promise slots/checkpoint, URL canonicalization, epoch correlation and native coarsening
compiledNts: not verified; maintainers own the compiled gate
wholeSuite: not run in this internal worktree; parent integration owns the final combined gate
